slots.jd.remodeling.about:
About us and the job
Rowan Remodeling is a remodeling contractor run by its owner. We take care with every job and treat each client's home with respect. We are looking for a journeyman carpenter to join our crew. The work is on site in Eugene, and you will work alongside the owner and the rest of the crew from start to finish.
slots.jd.remodeling.duties:
What the job involves
- Keep the site safe, clean and organised for the crew, clients and other trades.
- Order lumber and materials from the plans and check deliveries against the order.
- Frame walls and floors to plan, keeping them square, level and plumb.
- Read plans and take accurate measurements before cutting and building.
- Work with the owner to plan each day's tasks and keep jobs on schedule.
slots.jd.remodeling.needs:
What you need
- 4 or more years of experience as a carpenter.
- Hands-on skill in framing, stair building and concrete forming.
- Experience with door and window installation.
- Blueprint reading and careful measuring.
- Good jobsite safety habits, with a current Construction Safety Card (required).
- A Lead Carpenter Certificate is preferred.
slots.r1.b1: Builds forms for concrete footings and walls using layout and measuring, cutting form rework by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Reads plans and measures each room before cutting finish trim, keeping joints tight and lines straight.
slots.r1.b3: Orders lumber and materials for door and window installation from plan takeoffs, reducing leftover stock by 50 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Frames walls and floors to plan, using blueprint reading to set openings and heights correctly.
slots.r1.i1: Journeyman carpenter at Wren Valley Builders, keeping the site safe and orderly for the crew and other trades on every job.
slots.r1.i2: Journeyman carpenter at Wren Valley Builders, reading plans and taking measurements to build each job accurately and to code.
slots.r2.b1: Kept the site safe through jobsite safety checks and daily cleanup, cutting recorded near misses by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Installed doors, windows and trim, and assisted with concrete forming for entry slabs and thresholds.

slots.r2.b4: Read plans and took measurements to set heights and positions for scaffold erection and work platforms.

slots.summary.1: Journeyman carpenter with about 4 years of experience doing the work to code without supervision. Skilled in cabinet installation, layout and measuring, and jobsite safety, with a completed apprenticeship and a current Construction Safety Card.
slots.summary.2: Carpentry professional at journeyman level with about 4 years on job sites, completing work to code independently. Brings cabinet installation, layout and measuring, and jobsite safety to each project, backed by an apprenticeship certificate in carpentry.
